name: Investor Residence Permit (Real Estate, Business, or Job Creation)

requirements.blocker_text: Invest at least BGN 600,000 (approx. EUR 307,000) per foreigner to obtain title on real estate in Bulgaria, with bank-verified payment (Foreigners Act Article 24(1)(19)).
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate at or above the BGN 600,000 threshold.

requirement_groups.name: Commercial activity creating jobs for Bulgarian citizens

requirements.blocker_text: Engage in commercial activity in Bulgaria that creates and maintains at least 10 full-time jobs for Bulgarian citizens for the duration of residence (Article 24(1)(2)).
requirements.fix_path: Register a company and create at least 10 qualifying jobs.

requirement_groups.name: Investment in a designated disadvantaged region

requirements.blocker_text: Contribute at least BGN 250,000 in capital to a company operating in a designated disadvantaged region, holding at least a 50% ownership stake (Article 24(1)(20)).
Create and maintain at least 5 jobs for Bulgarian nationals throughout the residence period.

evidence_required.document: Property purchase deed or company incorporation and capital deposit records

outcome.duration_length: long-term residence permit, initial term up to 5 years, renewable while the investment/jobs are maintained

sources.title: Bulgaria -- Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, Article 24(1)(19): BGN 600,000 real estate investment; Article 24(1)(2): 10-job company route; Article 24(1)(20): BGN 250,000 disadvantaged-region investment with 5-job requirement

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). Note this is a RESIDENCE route only -- Bulgaria terminated its citizenship-by-investment (fast-track naturalisation for investors) program effective 5 April 2022; no direct investment-to-citizenship shortcut exists any more (see bg_naturalisation.json for the standard/only paths to citizenship, which an investor would still need to satisfy on ordinary residence-duration terms). Secondary sources (e.g. getgoldenvisa.com) also describe an alternative EUR 512,000 Alternative-Investment-Fund/ETF-based route said to grant permanent residence directly -- this could not be verified against primary legislative text in this pass and is NOT modeled as a separate requirement group; flagged for a future revisit.
